The '''''Sord Montok''''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] in use by the transport company [[Sord Montok]] for the conveyance of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. After picking up the Wookiee slave [[Reerookachuck]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], he caused a riot enabling him to escape. In the riot twenty guards were killed and thirty were injured, and while eighteen slaves escaped, thirteen were recaptured, ten of which were killed in the process. As a result, the [[Unidentified Sord Montok CEO|Sord Montok CEO]] placed a sixty-five thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the Wookiee to make an example of him and preserve the corporation's image.<ref name="BtDF" />
